string.text: Once a game day, kills, ground taken and fronts move the relations between factions, and wars, truces and alliances follow. Turned off, every faction goes back to the relations the game gave it.
Factions announce wars, truces and alliances on the PDA. With Everything, they also report the ground they take.
Once a game day, and once after each load, count every faction's squads and the ground they hold, and write it to fotz_census.jsonl in the game's appdata folder. It changes nothing in the game.

Relations change only between factions the base game lets change, within lore limits. Factions of the Zone steps aside while the base game's dynamic relations, Fluid Relations, Dynamic Faction Relations Customizer, or Warfare mode handle relations.
